html:
New Features

  • Linejam now keeps your poems and rooms safe with stronger security monitoring behind the scenes.
  • The game no longer includes machine-generated writing, so every line comes from a real person in the room.

Improvements

  • Joining a full, missing, or closed room now fails quietly without triggering error alerts.
  • Hosts and players should see more reliable room creation and joining after updates to the game's underlying services.
